purpose: Provide a public-safe response envelope for Primary Chat prose, links and passive widget descriptors without creating scheduler, queue, CURRENT or approval authority.

fields.prose: string or ordered array of bounded plain-text paragraphs
fields.links: bounded array of {label,href}; href accepts http(s) or non-protocol-relative local paths/anchors

run_progress_url_policy: relative/local refs or https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/ only; GET projection widget, no mutation authority

rendering.links: normalize through safeHref before anchor assignment
rendering.rich_response_present: replace message ui_blocks with normalized allowlisted blocks so unsafe legacy blocks cannot bypass the rich-response contract
rendering.invalid_rich_response: discard rich-response blocks and retain only bounded plain legacy body_text

privacy.public_projection: prose + safe links/widgets + sanitized durable evidence refs only
